reply.text:
This is one for a doctor, not a coach. A heart that feels off after COVID needs to be checked by a medical professional before you train again, and I won't guess at what it means or how much rest it needs.

Please stop training and contact your doctor soon, and if you get chest pain, fainting, a racing or irregular heartbeat, or shortness of breath, seek emergency care right away. When you're cleared, tell me what they say and I'll build the training around it, and we'll start from wherever you are.
